segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Banking segment provides banking and other financial services to large corporations, small- and medium-sized enterprises and individuals in Korea.
segments.evidence: This segment primarily consists of the banking operations of Woori Bank and its overseas subsidiaries.

segments.name: Life insurance
segments.description: Offers individual and group life insurance products, plus health insurance, through Tongyang Life Insurance and ABL Life Insurance.
segments.evidence: This segment consists of the life insurance operations of Tongyang Life Insurance and ABL Life Insurance.

segments.name: Credit card
segments.description: Offers credit card products and services mainly to consumers and corporate customers in Korea.
segments.evidence: This segment consists of the credit card operations of Woori Card.

segments.name: Capital
segments.description: Provides installment finance and loan services, including lease financing, mainly through Woori Financial Capital.
segments.evidence: This segment consists of the capital operations of Woori Financial Capital.

segments.name: Investment securities
segments.description: Investment securities segment, one of six operational business segments reported by the group.
segments.evidence: We currently have six operational business segments: banking, life insurance, credit card, capital, investment securities and other operations.

segments.name: Others
segments.description: Other operations reported beside the segments, including results attributable to Woori Financial Group on a separate basis.
segments.evidence: We currently have six operational business segments: banking, life insurance, credit card, capital, investment securities and other operations.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay fees for transactions and services, and interest is earned on financial assets such as loans.
revenueModel.evidence: These fees are recognized when transactions occur at the customers' request and services are provided, at the same time when commission are received.
